title: Executing a found path
context: After search reaches the goal, the slides recover the route from parent links.
text: The recovered plan reaches the goal only if every action behaves as the model predicts.
steps: Follow parent links from the goal back to the start.
Reverse the list to get the actions in order.
Execute them without observing again (open loop).
points: With disturbances, the agent can leave the plan.
It must then observe and search again, or follow a policy.
